WITH pv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, v.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
),
ing AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
cal AS (
  SELECT pv.seller_id FROM pv LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS calif FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = pv.order_id
  GROUP BY pv.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND AVG(r.calif) IS NOT NULL
),
tar AS (
  SELECT pv.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM pv WHERE pv.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_reviews WHERE review_answer_timestamp IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY pv.seller_id
),
ret AS (
  SELECT pv.seller_id FROM pv JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = pv.order_id WHERE review_answer_timestamp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pv.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendedores, SUM(ing.ingresos) AS ingresos
FROM ing JOIN cal ON cal.seller_id = ing.seller_id
JOIN tar ON tar.seller_id = cal.seller_id
JOIN ret ON ret.seller_id = cal.seller_id
WHERE cal.calif IS NOT NULL AND (cal.calif < 3.5 OR tar.pct_tarde > 15)
ORDER BY ing.ingresos DESC
LIMIT 25

  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = v.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE op.payment_type != 'not_defined' GROUP BY oi.order_id, t.product_category_name_english
